answer: I found two articles in effect today that still tell customers to use a retired form. "Selling a family member's car for them" tells customers to have NW-POA-1 signed in front of a notary. NW-POA-2 replaced NW-POA-1 on February 1, 2026, and an NW-POA-1 signed before that date was only accepted until June 30, 2026. "Broken or replaced odometer" tells customers to mark 'not actual mileage' on NW-ODO-1, which NW-ODO-2 replaced on February 1, 2026. These two are what my searches turned up, but the search can't list every article, so this may not be a complete audit.
